Selection under DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 takes place in two main stages:
Computer Based Test (CBT): A centralised online exam conducted all over India as per the datesheet prepared by DAVCMC. Demo-cum-Interview (Phase 3): Conducted separately by individual DAV schools
as and when advertised. Only candidates who clear both the demo and interview are offered employment. Schools may charge a nominal handling fee at this stage.
The CBT will be a computer-based exam of a total of 1.5 hours (90 minutes)
comprising two papers held one after the other in the same slot. Note: this is last year's pattern; the pattern for CBT 2027-28 may change and will be notified in November 2026.
There is no negative marking in the DAV CBT.
how_to_apply: Check advertisements for vacancies in different DAV schools/zones in national and regional newspapers (16 to 22 September 2026).
Visit the official DAV Recruitment website: davrecruit.davcmc.in.
Fill the online CBT Registration Form before 11 October 2026 and submit it as "Form Ready for Verification" (partial submission; the form remains editable at this stage).

Print the form and take it to the nearest DAV Verification Centre for verification of original testimonials (25 September to 16 October 2026). The school will verify and mark it "Verified and Approved for Payment"; after this, the form is locked.
Pay the CBT fee of Rs. 300/- online, within 7 days of approval, on the DAV Recruitment website only.
Wait for the datesheet, choose exam centre preference online (first-come-first-serve basis), and download the Admit Card once issued (November 2026).
Appear for the CBT as per the assigned date, shift, and centre (December 2026).

content_sections.heading: DAV Staff Recruitment Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection under DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 takes place in two main stages: Computer Based Test (CBT): A centralised online exam conducted all over India as per the datesheet prepared by DAVCMC. Demo-cum-Interview (Phase 3): Conducted separately by individual DAV schools, as and when advertised. Only candidates who clear both the demo and interview are offered employment. Schools may charge a nominal handling fee at this stage. The CBT will be a computer-based exam of a total of 1.5 hours (90 minutes), comprising two papers held one after the other in the same slot. Note: this is last year's pattern; the pattern for CBT 2027-28 may change and will be notified in November 2026. There is no negative marking in the DAV CBT.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required at the CBT Exam Centre
content_sections.text: Candidates will not be allowed entry into the exam centre without the following mandatory items: Printed/hard copy of the Admit Card One recent, coloured passport-size photograph Original government-issued photo ID (PAN card, Driving Licence, Voter ID, Passport, Aadhaar/E-Aadhaar, etc.) matching the name and photo on the Admit Card Prohibited items inside the exam centre include stationery items (printed/written material, calculators, pen drives, log tables, electronic pens/scanners), communication devices (smartwatch, mobile phone, Bluetooth devices, earphones, camera, etc.), wallets, goggles, handbags/pouches, and any opened or packed food item (except for diabetic candidates).

content_sections.heading: DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Online applications for DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 are accepted only through the official portal: davrecruit.davcmc.in . Candidates must use their own Registered Mobile Number (RMN) and personal email ID throughout the process - the same details are needed later for verification, Admit Card download, and the Provisional Eligibility Card (PEC). Each candidate may apply for one post only, and duplicate applications will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Instructions for CBT Registration and Login Form
content_sections.text: For Unregistered Users Please enter your full name, mobile number, and email address accurately. These details must belong to you. Your mobile number and email will be verified via OTP. Ensure you have access to the number and email you provide. The mobile number and password you provide will be used for all future logins. Choose a strong and memorable password. Please provide a valid email address. All official communication will be sent to this email. For Registered Users Enter your Username – This will be the mobile number that you provided during registration. Enter your Password – Use the same password that you created at the time of registration. Click on the "Login" button to access your account. If you have forgotten your password, use the "Forgot Password" option to reset it. Visit your nearest DAV Verification Centre to get the form verified by the Admin. After verification, log in again and go to Proceed to Payment to complete your payment.

faq.question: Q1. What is DAV Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a centralised recruitment drive by DAV College Managing Committee (DAVCMC) to fill Teaching and Non-Teaching posts across DAV schools in India through a Computer Based Test (CBT 2027-28).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DAV Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online CBT Registration Form must be submitted by 11October 2026, and verification at DAV Verification Centres continues till 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply online for DAV Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official portal davrecruit.davcmc.in by filling the CBT Registration Form, completing verification at a DAV Verification Centre, and paying the fee online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for DAV Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The CBT application fee is Rs. 300/-, payable online only, within 7 days of verification approval.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for DAV Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Demo-cum-Interview round (Phase 3) conducted by individual DAV schools.
